protocol: V6 executable baseline and ablation comparison

reference_label_protocol.primary: No independent adjudicated labels were available. Primary agreement/error rates are therefore not claimed; rows retain observed outputs and abstentions.
reference_label_protocol.mutation_faults: Applied-and-parseable destination mutations are known injected faults. Detection rates are supported fault-sensitivity measures for this operator set.
reference_label_protocol.no_abstention_policy: PRESERVED when the destination-only role/evidence predicate is present, otherwise LOST; this forced binary policy is reported as a sensitivity analysis, not ground truth.

baseline_definitions.tag_presence: destination tagged flag or StructTreeRoot marker; no source contract value
baseline_definitions.visible_text_equality: normalized source text is found in extracted destination text; no semantic structure or association check
baseline_definitions.destination_only_evidence: feature-specific destination role/marker presence without source expectation
baseline_definitions.without_secondary_evidence: frozen comparator with independent PyMuPDF/object-marker secondary evidence suppressed
baseline_definitions.without_abstention: forced binary role-presence policy with unresolved/measurement outcomes removed
baseline_definitions.full_a11ypreserve: source-grounded frozen comparator, multi-evidence classification, and explicit abstention

mutation_fault_sensitivity.fault_reference: operator-applied and parseable mutation; this is a known-fault oracle, not a human correctness label
